title: Hopi ant people emerging from underground

tellings.quote: And there's certain tribes like the Hopi tribe. You got the ant people and like these different stories where they would come up from the ground and they would assist people during times of great trouble and strife

plain: Among the Hopi, a Native American people, there are stories of "ant people" who came up from under the ground to help humans in times of great trouble and strife. A guest named Jay Anderson brings this up as one of several tribal stories of helpers from below, the kind that some read as memories of other beings living among us.
